mapper.select: SELECT i.symbol, i.name, w.priority, w.enabled FROM watchlist w JOIN instrument i ON i.id=w.instrument_id ORDER BY w.priority DESC, i.symbol
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist(instrument_id, priority, enabled) VALUES(#{id}, #{priority}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE priority= VALUES(priority), enabled=1
mapper.delete: DELETE w FROM watchlist w JOIN instrument i ON i.id=w.instrument_id WHERE i.symbol=#{symbol}
mapper.select: SELECT i.symbol, i.name, p.quantity, p.cost_price, p.as_of_date,p.risk_group FROM portfolio_position p JOIN instrument i ON i.id=p.instrument_id ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO portfolio_position(instrument_id, quantity, cost_price, as_of_date,risk_group) VALUES(#{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{costPrice}, #{asOfDate},#{riskGroup}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity= IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(quantity),quantity), cost_price= IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(cost_price),cost_price), risk_group=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(risk_group),risk_group), as_of_date= GREATEST(as_of_date,VALUES(as_of_date))

INSERT INTO portfolio_account(id, total_assets, as_of_date, risk_budget, liquidity_reserve, funds_needed_on, funds_purpose,cash_balance,positions_complete) VALUES(1, #{totalAssets}, #{asOfDate}, #{riskBudget}, #{liquidityReserve}, #{fundsNeededOn}, #{fundsPurpose},#{cashBalance},#{positionsComplete}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_assets=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(total_assets),total_assets), risk_budget=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(risk_budget),risk_budget), liquidity_reserve=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(liquidity_reserve),liquidity_reserve), funds_needed_on=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(funds_needed_on),funds_needed_on), funds_purpose=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(funds_purpose),funds_purpose), cash_balance=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(cash_balance),cash_balance), positions_complete=IF(VALUES(as_of_date)>=as_of_date,VALUES(positions_complete),positions_complete), as_of_date=GREATEST(as_of_date,VALUES(as_of_date))
